messages.content: What's the average temperature for Los Angeles in December?

message.content:
In December, Los Angeles enjoys mild, Mediterranean‑style weather. On average:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Average high | ~68 °F (≈20 °C) |
| Average low | ~48 °F (≈9 °C) |
| Mean (average of highs and lows) | ~58 °F (≈14 °C) |

So you can expect daytime temperatures around the upper 60s °F (mid‑20 °C) and nighttime lows in the upper 40s °F (around 9 °C). The city rarely sees freezing temperatures in December, and rainfall is relatively light compared to winter months in other parts of the U.S.
